title: University-wide bachelor requirements
notes: First bachelor degree completion and catalog-selection excerpts. Associate degrees, certificates, shared-credit graduate programs and second-degree policies are outside this set.
All thresholds constrain the same earned-credit record; they are not additive course blocks. These transcriptions do not evaluate a student.

rules.label: Total degree credit
rules.statement: Earn at least 120 semester credits. A program can require a higher total.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Admission to awarding college
rules.statement: Be admitted to the degree-awarding college at graduation.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: General Education
rules.statement: Complete the applicable UNM General Education requirements; see unm-general-education.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: University cultures requirement
rules.statement: Complete an approved 3-credit Critical Analyses of US and Global Cultures course with at least C. The requirement may overlap eligible Gen Ed or program coursework.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.
rules.approved_pool: Current University-approved cultures requirement course list; not enumerated in this bundle.

rules.label: Cultures overlap
rules.statement: An approved cultures course can also meet Gen Ed or program requirements when it meets their conditions; count its earned credits once toward the degree total.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: UNM residence
rules.statement: Earn at least 30 credits at UNM, excluding extension and correspondence independent-study credits.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Senior residence
rules.statement: Of the UNM residence credits, earn at least 15 after accumulating 92 earned credits. They need not be the final credits of the degree; summer attendance may qualify.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Cumulative GPA
rules.statement: Have a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: English writing competence
rules.statement: Complete ENGL 1120 with at least C, or meet the authorized proficiency-test alternative. A placement waiver does not itself award course credits.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

children.label: Authorized proficiency
children.statement: Qualifying score on an authorized writing proficiency test before graduation.

rules.label: CR/NC limit
rules.statement: Apply no more than 24 credits taken under the CR/NC grading option; college and program restrictions also apply.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Extension and correspondence limit
rules.statement: Apply no more than 40 extension/correspondence credits, of which no more than 30 may be correspondence credits.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Major residence
rules.statement: Complete at least half the minimum major credits as UNM class or laboratory work. A senior-transfer exception needs major-department approval and can reduce this to one quarter.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Minor residence
rules.statement: When completing a minor, earn at least one quarter of its minimum credits as UNM class or laboratory work.
rules.applies_when: A minor is part of the degree.

rules.label: Unresolved grades
rules.statement: Resolve all I and NR grades by the published end of the graduation semester.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Graduation application
rules.statement: Apply for degree candidacy and contact the college before the last semester. College deadlines may be earlier.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Catalog selection
rules.statement: Normally use the catalog in effect on admission to the degree-granting college; an internal college/program transfer uses the catalog in effect at transfer, subject to University changes.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Readmission catalog
rules.statement: An interruption of three or more consecutive semesters, counting summer, requires the catalog in effect on re-enrollment.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Ten-year catalog limit
rules.statement: A student taking more than ten years from original admission follows the catalog in effect in the intended graduation semester.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

attention.statement: The current cultures policy and Gen Ed program use Critical Analyses of US and Global Cultures; the graduation policy retains the earlier Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Power wording. Preserve this naming discrepancy and verify the approved list; do not create two additional 3-credit requirements.
